dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Sam is at-risk due to behavioral concerns. In the Care Centers, Sam is fearful. Initially, she would not allow staff to touch her and required several treats to coax her into interacting. Over time, she has become slightly more comfortable and will now allow some interaction, although she continues to require coaxing. Her owner reported that, in her previous home, Sam needed time to warm up to strangers and was sensitive to touch if not given time to be slowly introduced. She was reported to enjoy chicken, know the cues "sit" and "hand," and be gentle with the resident children. Medically, Sam is apparently healthy.

Sam was surrendered to the care centers by her owners due to their housing situation. She is described by her previous owners as a quiet, smart dog who loves to learn, and enjoys car rides and spending quality time with her people. During her time at the care centers, Sam has shown high levels of fear in her interactions with staff, consistently displaying a low body and tucked tail, avoidance of being leashed or handled, and has escalated to baring her teeth during her medical exam. While she has warmed up to handlers over time and shown some social behavior, due to her fearfulness, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
